rules: the bucket bare-cedar-fog-git-lfs carries binary asset bytes; the monorepo carries their pointers and all text

credential bytes reside only in the repository .env and are read at invocation; no key material is written into git config, the transfer agent's arguments as recorded by git, or any record under data/
the S3 access key is scoped to this one bucket and cannot enumerate the account's buckets
git-lfs runs as a standalone transfer agent, so no LFS API server is contacted and GitHub never carries asset bytes or meters their transfer
objects are stored uncompressed so bucket contents remain verifiable independently of git-lfs
